Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_09826_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

module rtlpp_09826(
    input            Wr_Strobe,		
    input            Rd_Strobe,		
    input      [7:0] AddrIn,			
    input      [7:0] DataIn,			
    output reg [7:0] DataOut,		
    input      [7:0] MotCtl,			
    output reg [7:0] LocX,			
    output reg [7:0] LocY,			
    output reg [7:0] BotInfo,		
    output reg [7:0] Sensors,		
    output reg [7:0] LMDist,			
    output reg [7:0] RMDist,			
    output reg [7:0] MapX,			
    output reg [7:0] MapY,			
    input      [1:0] MapVal,			
    input            clk,			
    input            reset,			
    output reg       upd_sysregs,		
    input      [7:0] BotConfig	
);

reg load_sys_regs;			
reg load_dist_regs;			

reg [7:0] LocX_int;			
reg [7:0] LocY_int;			
reg [7:0] BotInfo_int;		
reg [7:0] Sensors_int;		
reg [7:0] LMDist_int;			
reg [7:0] RMDist_int;			

always @(posedge clk) begin
    case (AddrIn[3:0])
        4'b0000: DataOut <= MotCtl;
        4'b0001: DataOut <= LocX_int;
        4'b0010: DataOut <= LocY_int;
        4'b0011: DataOut <= BotInfo_int;
        4'b0100: DataOut <= Sensors_int;
        4'b0101: DataOut <= LMDist_int;
        4'b0110: DataOut <= RMDist_int;
        4'b0111: DataOut <= BotConfig;
        4'b1000: DataOut <= MapX;
        4'b1001: DataOut <= MapY;
        4'b1010: DataOut <= {6'b0, MapVal};
        4'b1011: DataOut <= 8'd0;
        4'b1100: DataOut <= 8'b00000000;
        4'b1101: DataOut <= 8'b00000000;
        4'b1110: DataOut <= 8'b00000000;
        4'b1111: DataOut <= 8'd0;
    endcase
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        LocX_int <= 0;		
        LocY_int <= 0;
        BotInfo_int <= 0;
        Sensors_int <= 0;
        LMDist_int <= 0;
        RMDist_int <= 0;
        load_sys_regs <= 0;
        load_dist_regs <= 0;
        upd_sysregs <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        if(Wr_Strobe) begin
            case (AddrIn[3:0])
                4'b0000:  ;
                4'b0001:  LocX_int <= DataIn;
                4'b0010:  LocY_int <= DataIn;
                4'b0011:  BotInfo_int <= DataIn;
                4'b0100:  Sensors_int <= DataIn;
                4'b0101:  LMDist_int <= DataIn;
                4'b0110:  RMDist_int <= DataIn;
                4'b0111:  ;
                4'b1000:  MapX <= DataIn;
                4'b1001:  MapY <= DataIn;
                4'b1010:  ;
                4'b1011:  ;
                4'b1100:  load_sys_regs <= ~load_sys_regs;
                4'b1101:  load_dist_regs <= ~load_dist_regs;
                4'b1110:  upd_sysregs <= ~upd_sysregs;
                4'b1111:  ;
            endcase
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        LocX <= 0;
        LocY <= 0;
        Sensors <= 0;
        BotInfo <= 0;
    end
    else if (load_sys_regs) begin
        LocX <= LocX_int;
        LocY <= LocY_int;
        Sensors <= Sensors_int;
        BotInfo <= BotInfo_int;
    end
    else begin 
        LocX <= LocX;
        LocY <= LocY;
        Sensors <= Sensors;
        BotInfo <= BotInfo;
    end		
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        LMDist <= 0;
        RMDist <= 0;
    end
    else if (load_dist_regs) begin
        LMDist <= LMDist_int;
        RMDist <= RMDist_int;
    end
    else begin
        LMDist <= LMDist;
        RMDist <= RMDist;
    end		
end

endmodule
